name: Kushimoto (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kushimoto town emblem in green, light blue and orange: an orange stylised leaf crossed by green and light blue elliptical rings.
history: Municipal flag of Kushimoto, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 April 2006.
